Yes, there are two kinds. Which one fits depends on your Model Y's year.

## If you have a 2025-2026 Model Y (Juniper)
**Aurzen TravelPlay AutoCinema Screen, $119.99** ([buy at Aurzen](https://aurzen.com/products/aurzen-travelplay-autocinema-screen-for-tesla-model-y))
- It's a clip-in projector screen and sunshade for the rear window or panoramic roof, not a powered display. It clips in with no tools or drilling.
- You need a separate portable projector, which isn't included. Aurzen suggests its own ZIP or ZIP Pro.
- It's for use while parked only.
- Aurzen's MagPlay mount for rear-seat projection showed as unavailable in the US store on 2026-10-25, so plan on another way to position the projector.
- A third-party coupon site, Dealectric, lists code CJ10 for $11.99 off. It said the code worked in Aurzen's cart on 2026-10-24, but also says it can't combine with automatic sale prices. Aurzen is running a Halloween sale right now, so check at checkout. The [Dealectric page](https://dealectric.com/aurzen-travelplay-autocinema-tesla-model-y) is an affiliate link.

Most of the powered screens below are listed for 2019-2024 cars. I couldn't confirm a Juniper fit for them, so confirm with the seller before ordering.

## If you have a 2019-2024 Model Y
There are 8.66" Android touchscreens that mount on the back of the center console. They offer streaming, wireless CarPlay and Android Auto, and rear AC and seat-heat controls.
- **Amazon, about $280-$330 for most:** [browse the results](https://www.amazon.com/tesla-model-y-back-seat-screen/s?k=tesla+model+y+back+seat+screen). The listings with Android 13 and 4GB+64GB are the better specs. Ratings are mediocre, mostly 3.2-3.9 stars. The 4.5-star ($279.99) and 5-star ($210.99, Tlyard) listings have only 1-2 reviews, so I wouldn't trust them yet.
- **TESERY 8.66", $359:** [Tesery](https://www.tesery.com/products/tesery-8-66-inch-rear-entertainment-display-screen-for-tesla). It's rated 4.7 on its own site, but recent reviews mention lag, a screen that keeps going into child-lock mode, and apps that won't update. It lists Model Y fitment for 2020 through 2025.03 only.
- The Aear screen at SquareWheels ($299) is out of stock.

## My recommendation
- **2025-2026 Model Y:** the Aurzen screen, if you're happy to use a projector.
- **2019-2024 Model Y:** an Amazon 8.66" Android 13 unit with 4GB+64GB, since it's cheaper than Tesery and has Amazon's return window. Expect aftermarket-level polish, with some lag.

What year is your Model Y, and is this mainly for kids watching videos? That would let me narrow it down.
